description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.



About the Role:
Join CrowdStrike's AI Platform team to help build and scale our rapidly growing internal Generative AI platform that serves over 8,000 active users across the company and product lines. You'll develop robust backend services powering our comprehensive GenAI ecosystem — from retrieval-augmented generation systems and inference load balancing to autonomous agents and model orchestration frameworks. Our platform is both a direct productivity tool for everyday use and a foundation for teams to develop their own AI-powered solutions and agentic applications.


About the Team:


You'll join a high-performing team of experienced engineers building CrowdStrike's central AI Platform. We operate in a fast-paced environment where engineers are expected to own delivery of work with complete autonomy and trust. The team follows a startup mentality with weekly planning sessions and checkpoints, emphasizing quick execution without compromising quality. You'll collaborate closely with our data science team, UX designers, product managers, and AI champions from across the organization.


What You'll Do:


  • Design and implement scalable cloud services using Go in a cloud-native environment.
  • Build and operate production LLM integrations — from prompt engineering and context management to multi-step agentic workflows.
  • Design and implement autonomous agent systems capable of performing complex tasks with minimal human intervention.
  • Build reusable platform components and frameworks that other teams can leverage for their GenAI and agentic AI use-cases.
  • Develop and operate secure LLM deployments in both cloud and on-prem environments.
  • Create deep integrations with internal enterprise systems and establish frameworks for future connectors.
  • Build high-performance data processing pipelines for document handling and retrieval-augmented generation.
  • Engage directly with internal users across departments to understand requirements and provide technical consultation.
  • Own features end-to-end, from design through deployment and operation, including on-call responsibilities.
  • Drive innovation in the rapidly evolving Generative AI landscape.

What you'll Need:


  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 1 year working directly with LLMs and agentic systems in production
  • Hands-on experience building and shipping autonomous agent workflows — not just calling an LLM API, but orchestrating multi-step, tool-using agents
  • Practical LLM integration experience: prompt design, context window management, RAG pipelines, tool/function calling, and evaluating model outputs
  • Strong proficiency in Go or any modern programming language for backend service development
  • Deep understanding of cloud-native architectures and microservices
  • Experience with AWS services (S3, Bedrock, SageMaker, RDS)
  • Practical knowledge of operating production services — CI/CD, monitoring (Grafana, Prometheus), and Kubernetes
  • Strong grasp of multithreading, concurrency, and parallel processing
  • Knowledge of message queues and event-driven architectures
  • Experience in designing, building, and maintaining APIs aligned with industry standards
  • Understanding of engineering best practices — code reviews, testing, resilient architecture
  • Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills


Essential Qualities:


  • Genuine passion for Generative AI — you follow the space closely and have opinions on models, frameworks, and agent patterns.
  • Self-starter mentality with proven ability to drive projects independently.
  • Comfortable managing multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proactive in identifying and solving technical challenges.
  • Strong collaboration skills for working with diverse stakeholders.
  • Ability to make technical decisions with incomplete information.
  • Enthusiasm for pushing beyond existing agent patterns, not just implementing known solutions.

Bonus Points:


  • Experience as a technical lead or team lead, coordinating projects and partnering with engineering management on roadmap planning
  • Understanding of vector databases and retrieval-augmented generation implementations
  • Security-first mindset with experience building systems that meet high privacy and compliance requirements
  • Background in enterprise SaaS products
  • Track record of mentoring other engineers

#LI-DM1


Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:

  • Market leader in compensation and equity awards
  • Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs
  • Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge
  • Paid parental and adoption leaves
  • Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role
  • Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections
  • Vibrant office culture with world class amenities
  • Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe

CrowdStrike is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging where everyone is valued for who they are and empowered to succeed. We support veterans and individuals with disabilities through our affirmative action program.
